about: Held-out Hebrew → English search probe for plan W2.11 (plan W10.B6): 30 everyday Hebrew queries, each about one short English note. Written on 15.11.2026 by an AI agent (lane X-B), AFTER the dev probe and the HE_EN lexicon existed, so it is not blind in the strict sense. To keep it out of tuning: the file is frozen (its sha256 is pinned in src/__tests__/hebrewMorph.test.ts), the English terms the lexicon gave each query at freeze time are recorded in englishAtFreeze, and the test fails if the lexicon gains a term for a held-out query. Synthetic (written here), not real user queries. Report this probe's result, not the dev probe's.

doc.text: Vegetarian cookbooks I want to borrow from the library: three titles with lentil and chickpea dishes.
Booked a table for four at the Italian restaurant on Thursday at eight.
Changed the flat tyre on the highway; the spare is now in use, buy a new one.
The electricity bill doubled this winter; check the heater and the boiler timer.
Math homework for Sunday: fractions, pages 40 to 42, and a short quiz.
Eye doctor visit next Monday; bring the old glasses and the prescription.
Birthday gift ideas for Mom: a scarf, a pottery class or a weekend away.
Gym strength workout: squats, deadlifts and bench press, three sets each.
Apartment for rent in Haifa: two rooms, near the beach, available in March.
Clean the air conditioner filters before summer and call a technician for the gas.
Online Python programming course: loops, functions and a small final project.
The dog's rabies vaccine is due; the vet clinic opens at nine.
Wedding guest list: family first, then friends from work, about 180 people.
The kitchen faucet is dripping; replace the washer or call the plumber.
Finished a thriller novel last night; the twist in the final chapter surprised me.
Income tax refund form submitted; the money should arrive within ninety days.
Family hike in the Galilee: a stream trail, a picnic and a visit to a goat farm.
Updating my resume: add the last job, shorten the education part, one page only.
Balcony gardening: tomatoes and basil in pots, water every morning.
Kindergarten registration closes in February; prepare the ID and vaccination record.
Selling the old car: take photos, check the price list and post the ad.
Video call with Grandma on Saturday evening; help her set up the tablet camera.
Lentil soup: onion, carrot, red lentils and cumin, cook for half an hour.
Pay the municipal property tax before the end of the month to get the discount.
Back pain from sitting all day: stretch every hour and raise the screen.
Learning Spanish with an app: ten minutes a day, verbs and short dialogues.
Moving checklist: boxes, a moving company quote, change the address at the bank.
Final university project: choose a topic, meet the supervisor, submit a proposal.
Wash the wool coat by hand in cold water and dry it flat.
The internet router keeps disconnecting; restart it and call the provider.
